mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings declines and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both below 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production growth exceeding 1.0% annually, the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% annually, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market, which typically supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, which typically triggers central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reaction to inflation data.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and weak housing starts (HOUST < 450) signals a broad economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0 and HOUST < 450, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as central banks maintain accommodative policies to support growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
